description: Enqueue an event for your verified receiver, idempotent by eventId and exact bytes.

bodyBase64.description: Canonical base64 payload, at most 65536 decoded bytes. Preserve exact bytes with eventId on retries.

hookId.description: Hook identifier returned by registration; preserve for all subsequent operations.

token.description: Private 32-byte secret encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Never expose in logs.

name: accept_hook_event
